card.name: Predicting river tributary words
card.fires_on: The start of "tributary" (or words just before it like "principal", "its", "one of") after a river name in geography text. Weaker on words leading into vein or artery terms.

modes.label: River tributaries
modes.description: The first piece of "tributary" or the words leading into it, after a river or river system.
modes.example: The Río Negro's principal<< trib>>utary and the country's second most

modes.label: Blood vessel terms
modes.description: Linking words before vein or artery names in anatomy or imaging text.
modes.example: A very small amount of radioactive material is injected into<< a>> vein and travels through the bloodstream.

card.writes: It pushes the model toward trib- (tributary) and flow or vein words.
card.plain: It fires when the text is about to say that a river is a tributary of another, and a little for veins and arteries.
